d:
The gaming industry is booming in India, but there’s a catch—despite 568M gamers, India only captures 1.5% of global gaming revenue. Why is that? Why do Indian gamers spend less than their Western counterparts? And how are global studios like EA, Zynga, and Tencent entering the Indian market?
In this deep dive, we break down the numbers and reveal:
• The difference between Indian & international gaming markets
• Why 90% of Indian gamers play on mobile
• The monetization problem—why Indian gamers don’t pay
• The rise of esports and mobile gaming in India
